scope: MCX-TRADER Dhan authentication contract as implemented by the application (no values included)
broker: Dhan (api.dhan.co) via official dhanhq SDK + pyotp

optional_credentials.name: TRADING_PIN
optional_credentials.purpose: PIN+TOTP auto-renewal (no browser) via DhanLogin.generate_token(pin, totp)

renewal.mechanism: data/dhan/rest_client.py DhanRESTClient.renew_token(): pyotp.TOTP(totp_secret).now() -> dhanhq.DhanLogin(client_id).generate_token(pin, totp) -> write access_token to token_file
triggers: ensure_token() when JWT exp within 1h grace
renewal.renewal_source_of_truth: JWT exp claim (no API validate call to avoid waste)

engine_integration.config/settings.json: dhan.* entries use ${...} env placeholders resolved by Config.load() against os.environ
setup_env_and_token loads mcx-trader.env, exports to os.environ, seeds data/db/dhan_token.json from DHAN_ACCESS_TOKEN, builds DhanDataAdapter(client_id, token_file, pin=TRADING_PIN, totp_secret=TOTP_SECRET)

auth_state_definition: runner: 'valid' if JWT exp in future; 'expired_renewal_possible' if expired but TRADING_PIN+TOTP_SECRET both set; 'expired_no_renewal' otherwise
